name: Panarottis George
address: 126A York St, George Central, George, 6530, South Africa
description_short: Family-friendly Italian chain serving pizza, pasta and desserts in central George.
description_long:
Located on York Street in the heart of George, Panarottis offers a reliable Italian dining experience that's become a go-to for families and groups. The menu covers all the classics—wood-fired pizzas with generous toppings, hearty pasta dishes, and a dedicated kids' menu that keeps the little ones happy.

The atmosphere is casual and welcoming, with booth seating and a layout that works well for larger gatherings. Breakfast is served daily, featuring everything from Mediterranean-inspired options to full English platters. Their dessert selection, including indulgent chocolate brownies and gelato, rounds out the meal nicely.

As part of a well-known South African chain, Panarottis George delivers consistent quality and service. The central location makes it convenient for both locals and visitors exploring the Garden Route, with takeaway options available for those on the move.
